head: AI trip planner app My City Days plans city days for one price per trip
dek: My City Days is a new iPhone app that makes a day-by-day plan for a city trip from where you're going, how many days you have and what you like. It costs $8.99, and each trip plan is a separate one-time in-app purchase on top.
details: The plan includes places, food spots, a route for each day and travel tips, and there's no subscription. It came out on 11 November, is made by Aliya Abisheva, is in English and needs iOS 15 or later. It was #64 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 12 November. The listing doesn't give the price of a trip plan, and the app has no ratings yet.
means: If you want a ready plan for a city break, this app makes one, but you pay for the app and again for every trip.
todo: Check the price of a trip plan in the app before buying, and compare it with free trip planners.
